news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹1.63 (vs ₹1.41 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹1.63 (up from ₹1.41 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹364.6m (up 21% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹62.1m (up 23% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 17% (in line with 3Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 96% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 89% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.

news.title: UVS Hospitality and Services Limited announced that it expects to receive INR 237.425 million in funding
news.body: UVS Hospitality and Services Limited announced a private placement to issue 1,583,000 equity shares at an issue price of INR 100 for the proceeds of INR 158,300,000 and 3,165,000 convertible warrants at an issue price of INR 25 for the proceeds of INR 79,125,000 on February 14, 2025. Transaction involves participation of SUDHAKAR NARAYAN SANKU for 200,000, MURLIDHAR MOHANLAL LAKHIANI HUF for 125,000, REDDY SRINIVASA REDDY for 100,000, MALLINATH MADINENI HUF for 1,000,000, SKYBRIDGE VENTURES LLP for 750,000 warrant and other investors  Warrant is exercisable at INR 75 and exercisable within 18 months of allotment. Transaction is approved by board of directors and is still subject to shareholder and regulatory authority approval.

news.title: UVS Hospitality and Services Limited announced that it expects to receive INR 237.05 million in funding
news.body: UVS HOSPITALITY AND SERVICES LIMITED announced a private placement to issue 1,583,000 equity shares at an issue price of INR 100 per share for gross proceeds of INR 158,300,000 and 3,165,000 warrants at an issue price of INR 25 per warrant for gross proceeds of INR 79,125,000; aggregate gross proceeds of INR 237,425,000 on February 14, 2026. The transaction will include participation from new investors NAVIN GOVIND AGRAWAL 4,23,094 shares, DEVINENI YASWANTH RAJA 68,437 shares, MAMATHA SANDEEP RATHOD  68,437 shares and others. The transaction has been approved by shareholders, Subject to the approval of the shareholders of the Company and such other regulatory/ statutory approval.

news.title: UVS Hospitality and Services Limited Announces Resignation of Rashmi Chandrakant Vartak as Managing Director, Effective January 23, 2026
news.body: UVS Hospitality and Services Limited announced that Mrs. Rashmi Chandrakant Vartak (DIN: 10259700), has tendered her resignation as a Managing Director of the Company with immediate effect on January 23, 2026 due to personal reasons.

news.title: UVS Hospitality and Services Limited Announces Cessation of Rashmi Chandrakant Vartak as Member of Board Committees, Effective January 23, 2026
news.body: UVS Hospitality and Services Limited announced that Mrs. Rashmi Chandrakant Vartak ceased to be the member in various Committees, where she is a member due to the resignation as managing director because of personal reasons. The cessation is effective January 23, 2026.

news.title: UVS Hospitality and Services Limited Announces Resignation of Uma Rani Patil as Independent Director and Member of Board Committees, Effective January 22, 2026
news.body: UVS Hospitality and Services Limited announced that Mrs. Uma Rani Patil (DIN: 10963796) has resigned from the position of Independent Director of the Company with immediate effect on January 22, 2026 due to health-related personal reasons. Consequent to her resignation, she also ceases to be the member in various Committees, where she is a member.
